title: Editorial & samples
intro: Sample content (Editorial and sample accounts): where it shows and which items you hid one by one. In production it stays off until real builds with written consent exist.

flag.title: Visibility per environment
flag.caption: Sample content per environment
flag.pending: A change is waiting for approval (four-eyes).
flag.view_only: Only owners and admins switch the samples.
flag.error: The flag could not be loaded.
flag.missing_title: The sample content switch is missing
flag.missing_body: It comes with the platform’s base data. Let the development team know.

flag_dialog.on_body: Sample builds, meets and businesses show again in the app and on public pages, each marked “Sample”. Items hidden one by one stay hidden.
flag_dialog.off_body: No member and no public page shows sample content any more. The data stays.

summary.title: Inventory
summary.none: There is no sample content here. The samples come with the demo data set, locally and on staging.

items.title: Sample content
items.view_only: You can only view the samples. Roles that edit content can hide them.
items.caption_vehicle: Sample builds with account, visibility and creation date
items.caption_event: Sample meets with account, visibility and creation date
items.caption_business: Sample businesses with account, visibility and creation date

state_hint.shown: Members see it while samples are visible here.
state_hint.withdrawn: Private or removed, not through this page.

empty.vehicle_body: The sample builds come with the demo data set.
empty.event_body: The sample meets come with the demo data set.
empty.business_body: The sample businesses come with the demo data set.

item_dialog.hide_body_vehicle: The build becomes private: it leaves Home, Discover, search and its public page. Nobody is notified.
item_dialog.hide_body_event: The meet leaves the calendar, the map and its public page. Nobody is notified.
item_dialog.hide_body_business: The business leaves the lists and its public page. Nobody is notified.
item_dialog.show_body: It shows again as before it was hidden, while samples are visible here.

errors.not_sample: This is not sample content. Hide real content through moderation.
errors.not_visible: Not public right now, there is nothing to hide.

flash.hidden: Hidden. Members no longer see it.
flash.changed: Changed otherwise in the meantime, so not restored. Check the record.
